sites.name: Atacama Desert (Yungay region, Mars analog)
sites.summary: Wikipedia gives desert centre 24.5S 69.25W and says the Yungay area is a Mars analog used by NASA to test Mars instruments. NASA page https://astrobiology.nasa.gov/news/nasa-tests-life-detection-drill-in-the-atacama-desert/ confirms Yungay Station drill tests but gives no coordinates.
